rules.pairing: same policy/bank/target/speed and explicit B1,B2,B3,B4,R3,R4; never collapse duplicate targets
rules.primary_inclusion: all12, including B3_counter and R3_counter onset warnings, flags unchanged
rules.strict_sensitivity: only pairs with both original run_complete true
rules.balance: official reducer; standing R0 drift; scalar tilt deviation from first observed task sample
rules.spatial: 1001 uniform arc-length samples of observed move wrist path; frozen and live rotation gauges omit world translation
rules.timed: trajectory sampled on observation arrival clock at saved executed duration; official sample RMS
rules.supplementary: onset SO3/gravity reference first recorded task sample; observed-window trapezoid RMS
rules.inference: none; no pooling new with historical, no policy causal effect under blocked FAME then ALMI order
